height.meaning: A fixed visual overview baseline for generalized real built-up land-use blocks; not an actual or measured building height. Height does not vary with carbon budget.

geometry.simplification: Source polygons simplified in UTM 50N with 5m topology-preserving tolerance; intersected with real ICB display cells; final coordinates snapped to 0.000001 degree.

budget.meaning: Actual IATP allocation quota of the intersecting cell, not emissions of the land parcel or its buildings.
budget.classification: Exactly the source API color_config; no reclassification or fabricated values.
budget.nodata_policy: Omit actual null cells; no numerical filling.

attribution: Local IATP land-use source carries OSM IDs but does not state its acquisition date or license. Retain source provenance and existing map attribution. No claim of measured 3D city buildings is made.
